verdict.rationale: Snyk Code docs say you can configure Snyk to ignore issues and suppress specific warnings (snyk-docs-5), and the plans page lists policy management (snyk-docs-32), so the ignore/suppress half of the story is documented, though only thinly. Nothing in the pack shows baselining existing findings or alerting only on newly introduced issues. Missing for 10: baseline of existing findings, new-issues-only alerting or gating, documented false-positive marking workflow across products (Open Source, Container, IaC), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
